notes: BATCH X (hyoscine-butylbromide, dicycloverine, mebeverine, otilonium, pinaverium, chlordiazepoxide-clidinium, simeticone). BNF/BNFC not accessed (geo-blocked). NO UK PRODUCT: otilonium, pinaverium (no emc or MHRA SPC/PIL/PAR hits) and chlordiazepoxide-clidinium (clidinium has no UK product; only single-ingredient chlordiazepoxide capsules exist, not used). FORM GAPS: hyoscine butylbromide syrup has no UK oral liquid; rules and safety sections come from the UK 10 mg tablet SmPCs and doses are tablet-only. Dicycloverine: clinic lists 50 mg tablets but UK tablets are 10 mg and 20 mg only; the oral solution SmPC (emc 8946, contraindicated under 6 months) was not used because the clinic product is a tablet. Simeticone: no UK simeticone-only tablet; capsule SmPC (UK 100 mg capsule SmPC) used; the levothyroxine interaction comes from an infant suspension SmPC (emc 6612) and is applied to the ingredient. ANTIMUSCARINIC CONTRAINDICATIONS: hyoscine butylbromide SmPC 4.3 lists myasthenia gravis, mechanical GI stenosis, paralytic/obstructive ileus, megacolon and narrow-angle glaucoma (all rules contraindicated); tachycardia conditions are 4.4 caution (rules on tachyarrhythmia, thyrotoxicosis, heart-failure, severe-heart-failure). Dicycloverine UK tablet SmPCs do NOT list these as contraindications: glaucoma and prostatic hypertrophy are 4.4 caution only; no myasthenia/obstruction/megacolon/tachyarrhythmia statements, so no rules were made for them. Mebeverine SmPC says typical anticholinergic systemic effects are absent, so it is NOT put in the anticholinergic group. INTERACTION MAPPING: hyoscine 4.5 "beta-adrenergic agents" mapped to group:beta2-agonist (no members added here); "tri- and tetracyclic antidepressants" mapped to group:tricyclic-antidepressant; tiotropium and ipratropium added to group anticholinergic and metoclopramide to dopamine-antagonist from the hyoscine SmPC 4.5 wording. Interaction rules are level info because the SmPC states the effect but no action. CONFLICTS (kept as separate items/rules): hyoscine breastfeeding SmPC "not recommended" vs SPS "preferred choice" with infant monitoring; hyoscine pregnancy SmPC "not recommended" vs BUMPS "only if no alternative"; hyoscine children 6-12 years dosed in general 10 mg tablet SmPCs vs IBS-only tablet "under 12 not recommended" (age rule scoped to IBS wording); dicycloverine breastfeeding SmPC caution vs SPS "not recommended"; dicycloverine children 2-12 dosed in one SmPC but not in another; mebeverine breastfeeding SmPC "should not be used" vs SPS "use with caution"; mebeverine pregnancy SmPC "not recommended" vs BUMPS "occasionally used if needed"; simeticone breastfeeding SmPC caution vs SPS preferred choice. MHRA DSU on hyoscine butylbromide relates to the injection only (not used). No UK source requires brand-name prescribing for any batch X medicine. AUDIT 2026-10-17 (second checker): MHRA products index shows a Public Assessment Report refusing UK marketing authorisations for hyoscine butylbromide 5 mg/5 ml oral solution (PL 20117/0458-0459, finalised 06 June 2025); added to the syrup formulation note as source mhra-par-hyoscine-oral-solution-2025. Otilonium, pinaverium and clidinium re-searched: emc search and the MHRA products search index return no documents.
